title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC equity — head when he sinned; sin loco nostro, not punished loco nostro
pass_a_gloss: He treated Adam as our head when Adam sinned, but refused to treat him that way when Adam was being punished; he willed Adam to sin in our place, yet not to be punished in our place.
pass_b_english: He considered him our head when he sinned, and refused to consider him in the same way when he was being punished.
He willed him to sin in our place, and refused that he be punished in our place.
source_text: Consideraverit eum cum peccavit ut caput nostrum, noluerit eum eodem modo considerare cum puniretur: voluerit eum peccare loco nostro, noluerit puniri loco nostro.

choices.choice: Head for sin; loco for sin not for punishment
